game.title: Persona 3 Reload
game.blurb: Reimagined RPG in which a transfer student awakens a power in the hidden Dark Hour between one day and the next, and fights for friends, from Atlus, released 2024-02-01. RAWG average playtime: 29 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The school year and the mysteries of the Dark Hour. Spoiler-guarded; the story achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: School Life and Social Links
chapters.summary: Social Links, romance, exams, Social Stats, part-time jobs, the dorm, the garden, the cat and hang-outs.

chapters.title: Tartarus and Battles
chapters.summary: Shuffle Time, Shifts, Theurgy, All-Out Attacks, golden enemies, Monad doors, chests, Twilight Fragments and the Reaper.

chapters.title: Personas and Fusion
chapters.summary: Dyad and multi-Persona fusions, Persona Conception, skill changes, Messiah and the wild card.

chapters.title: Episode Aigis (likely)
chapters.summary: The last block of hidden achievements, which probably belong to the Episode Aigis add-on. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2161700)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Persona_3_Reload
Fandom (megamitensei.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Persona_3_Reload
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0 (a stub); the only written subpages are "Achievements and trophies" (about 7,700 characters) and a short Table of Contents (404 characters). Its Walkthrough, Controls and Gameplay pages are linked but not written. megamitensei.fandom.com answers the API, with 500 or more linked pages (the list was cut off at 500), including "Persona 3 Reload: Episode Aigis Original Soundtrack", "Monad Depths", "Elizabeth's Requests" and "Linked Episodes"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Libra" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2161700. 19 of 56 Steam achievements are hidden. Twelve (1 to 11 and 19) sit in the main story chapter. Many visible descriptions say "(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)", which suggests a second mode; the last seven hidden achievements (50 to 56, "The Vengeful One" to "Together, Into Tomorrow", each about 7 to 9 percent) form one block at the end and were put in an "Episode Aigis" chapter by position and by the Fandom soundtrack page name, which needs checking. "Realized Power" (49, awakening to the wild card, 12.3 percent) sits just before that block and may belong to it too; it was kept with Personas and Fusion.
